notes: AlvaAR remains the only camera-pose authority. Depth Anything V2 Small is restored as a lazy sparse keyframe prior: only spatially novel views with enough Alva-triangulated anchors trigger inference. Relative AI depth is robustly calibrated into the current Alva world scale, then used only to narrow multi-view plane-sweep search before surfel/TSDF fusion. Near-duplicate unprioritized frames are skipped to prevent camera-facing depth sheets. The neural model is not a scan-startup dependency.
